biology: Broad curated TGF-beta response programme, not a direct ligand-activity measurement
source: MSigDB Hallmark M5896; Liberzon et al.2015,PMID26771021
definition_provenance: Official MSigDB54genes retrieved in prior audited review; official page reopened16Nov2026
clinical_validation: Not validated to select vactosertib response in CRC
analysis_status: primary pathway family; published biological signature, not a clinical predictor

source: Mariathasan et al. Nature2018, pan-fibroblast TGF-beta response signature; exact membership corroborated by authors/Genentech patent and independently republished tables
verification_status: Exact19membership corroborated by primary patent full-list indexed content and later published Table5; original Nature/PMC SupplementaryTable8 download returned HTML and was not directly inspected.
context: Response signature derived across fibroblast tissues; association with atezolizumab nonresponse principally in immune-excluded metastatic urothelial cancer; mouse EMT6 and MC38 intervention models.
interpretation_limits: Bulk score includes contractile/smooth-muscle genes; cell composition must be checked.
Not Calon colon-fibroblast F-TBRS165, Hallmark TGF-beta, or Gut CTHRC1 classifier.
No validated MSS CRC response threshold; use exploratory score with source caveat.
analysis_status: primary pathway family; published biological signature, not a clinical predictor

definition: Exact 11-gene set explicitly listed in main Results to infer presence of TGF-beta CAFs across cancer types from bulk TCGA RNA-seq.
context: Derived from fibroblast single-cell lineage analysis, primarily pancreatic cancer models; tested as bulk expression signature including immunotherapy cohorts across six cancer types.
interpretation_limits: Not a direct phospho-SMAD activity assay.
Bulk score conflates CAF abundance with per-cell state.
Not a validated predictive biomarker for anti-TGF-beta therapy in MSS colorectal cancer.
Not the Gut2026 CTHRC1 CAF classifier or a substitute for spatial exclusion measurement.
analysis_status: primary pathway family; published biological signature, not a clinical predictor

source: Chakravarthy et al. Nat Commun2018, Supplementary Table2
definition: Exact genes labelled is.upSig/is.downSig in Supplementary Table2, extracted from PDF pages8-11.
context: Pan-cancer bulk tumour-versus-normal extracellular-matrix expression; stromal/fibroblast origin assessed, including CRC separated compartments; immunotherapy associations from melanoma/urothelial contexts.
interpretation_limits: ECM-up and ECM-down are distinct cancer-versus-normal signatures, not positive/negative TGF signalling assays.
Bulk abundance confounding persists; down set includes normal tissue fibroblast/smooth-muscle markers.
Not a validated CRC anti-stromal response selector.
analysis_status: primary pathway family; published biological signature, not a clinical predictor
